response.enhanced_information: Aprepitant, Dexamethasone, and Ondansetron are all used to manage chemotherapy-induced vomiting, each acting through different mechanisms: Aprepitant as an NK1 receptor antagonist, Dexamethasone as a corticosteroid and antiemetic, and Ondansetron as a 5-HT3 receptor antagonist. These drugs are often used in combination to achieve a synergistic effect in preventing nausea and vomiting associated with chemotherapy.
